problem: Problem Radar research, portal intelligence and content reuse had the right components but no single general machine-readable contract guaranteed that every accepted MKB signal was stored once and routed through all applicable canonical projections.
root_cause: People evidence had a dedicated source registry and the broader Voice-of-Customer skill described the loop in prose, but cross-domain intake/storage/dedupe/portal/content obligations were not expressed as one reusable contract.
fix: Add canonical Problem Radar intake and routing contract
Require provenance, freshness, confidence and PH-Pxxx-first mapping
Require portal projection to distinguish external context from tenant evidence
Make blog and LinkedIn-company reuse an explicit governed projection
Bind outcome learning to Verified Value
Reconcile inherited website release-risk regression with the current bounded route-concurrency verifier without weakening full-route, viewport, CLS or visibility checks
prevention_rule: Every future Dutch MKB signal must enter through the canonical intake contract; accepted evidence cannot terminate as a content-only note, a portal-only fact, or a parallel problem taxonomy.

invariants: external evidence is never tenant fact by itself
accepted evidence is eligible for portal, opportunity and content reuse
publication and realized value remain readback/evidence gated
stale website regression asserts the current bounded concurrent full-route sweep instead of requiring the superseded serial loop

integration_recovery.root_cause: Current main had already changed standalone visibility verification from serial route iteration to bounded worker concurrency, while tests/site-shell-website-release-risk.test.mjs still asserted the superseded serial `for (const route of routes)` mechanism.
integration_recovery.repair: Migrate the stale baseline assertion to the canonical bounded-concurrency semantics without weakening full-route, viewport, CLS or fail-closed guarantees.
integration_recovery.prevention: When a canonical verifier changes execution strategy, co-migrate all tests that assert the old mechanism; preserve semantic safety invariants rather than implementation shape.

production_proof.feature_containment: production commit is 2 commits ahead of feature merge with feature merge as merge base
production_proof.note: The later governance-recovery merge changes learning metadata only and does not change the portal/runtime behavior proven by the production descendant.
